messages.content:
Evolve the basic motor start/stop timing block into a massive Food & Beverage Clean-In-Place (CIP) sequencer in IEC 61131-3 Structured Text.
Requirements:
1. Include strict FDA compliance timing checks: timers must pause if temperature or concentration drops below setpoints.
2. Caustic and acid concentration monitoring via conductivity feedback.
3. Abort sequences if the flow rate drops below sanitary minimums (turbulent flow).
4. Implement complex state machines, safety interlocks (e-stops, thermal overloads), and hardware abstractions via UDTs.
5. Provide flawless, professional comments.
